item.tib: ma mo sbod gtong snang srid zil gnon las bzhi rgyun gyi 'phyong las 'dod blo'i kha skong lhan thabs kyi rim pa
item.coloph: ces pa rang gzhung nam mkha'i nor bu ltar ma tshangs pa min kyang / gang zag 'dod gdung sel ba'i kha skong lhan thabs kyi rim pa 'di yang thos chung mu la wang ya la 'tsho byed pa g.yung drung gtsug phud kyis bskul ngor mi ldog tsam du bris pa'o//
